svg.text: アナロジーは直感用。電流は閉回路を流れて戻る。

text.font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', Meiryo, sans-serif

svg.text: Analogy only; current returns in a closed loop.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', Meiryo, sans-serif

svg.text: アナロジーの限界: 電圧は2点間の差、交流は向きが変わる、コイルは逆起電力を生む。

text.font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', Meiryo, sans-serif

svg.text: Limits: voltage is a difference between two points; AC changes direction; coils produce back-EMF.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', Meiryo, sans-serif

svg.text: 電圧は電位差、電流は電荷の流れ、抵抗は流れにくさ、電力はエネルギーの移動速度。

text.font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', Meiryo, sans-serif

svg.text: Voltage is a potential difference, current is charge flow, resistance opposes flow and power is the rate of energy transfer.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', Meiryo, sans-serif
